full_page.content:
1932, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 28 Cont.
May 22 Mrs. Marg. Legroat - pneumonia & 2 little boys 3 & 5 Helen P. (5) in Children's Hosp. - brights - 28 1bs - fever all time .... Mrs. Clara Parks - 50 - fears operation - kidney stones Gert 0'Neil - 11 - heart trouble - 6 mo. in bed. Blank Page
Page 39 Page 40 May 29 Wm. Hayes - 2 Special Int's
Edw'd Monnette - 62 - of 2246 Jerome - Toledo, 0. - Heart trouble etc. Would fall down like dead, was enrolled as a perpetual member - had not worked for months, went back to work following Thursday - Completely cured, returns To-day after two years a young looking man.
Edw'd Rosinski - 9 mo. - threatened with mastoid.
Charles Keith Haley - 5 - paralysis ...
Nellie May Little
Ms. Law .... near Cath. School Helen Byrne - 8 - south Woodlee - bad ankle & hip. Fr. W. - Wayward husband - 14 years away from confession - sinus ... Macell Viane .... Deaf Dorothy Frank - 15 - T.B. in hip - fell at Xmas when just recovering from "flu" - father out of work 6 mo.
Page 41 May Anna Steninger of Covington, K. - cancer internal & external - a year ago was expected to die ....
Page 42 June
1932, June
Omer DeWolf - 18 - working in butcher shop .... 5 transfusions of blood - leg already cut off.
